self-correction.objective: Record all existing routes, interactive behavior and screenshots before edits; never regress a passed baseline.
Start an allowlisted local development server and verify the ready endpoint rather than trusting process start.
Collect screenshots across 320–1920 CSS px, reduced-motion, scroll phases and RTL.
Reproduce and isolate a defect before editing; record DOM selector, source file and evidence path.
Permit max four corrective rounds with explicit write permission and no edits outside project.
Require clean working tree before auto-edits; produce git diff for human inspection, never silent reset.
Normalize screenshot environment, compare exact dimensions, route states and interaction phases.
Stop repairs when previous high-severity issues increase; preserve successful functionality.
Turn every reproduced defect into a repeatable Playwright check.
Distinguish PASS, FAIL and NOT_TESTED and link concrete artifacts.
Require human acceptance for subjective composition and brand choices after objective tests.
Offer safe manually reviewed git restore steps, never destructive cleanup by default.

three-modeling.objective: Choose geometry based on shape silhouette, triangle budget, detail levels and asset units.
Inspect glTF node graph, texture weight, pivot axes, normals and potential missing textures.
Run updateWorldMatrix and Box3.setFromObject before computing camera and object transforms.
Derive camera distance from horizontal and vertical FOV, target content slot and bounding sphere.
Compute orthographic frustum spans from bounded geometry and slot aspect ratio.
Measure DOM text rectangles and reserve an explicit unobstructed screen-space 3D slot.
Distinguish visual mesh center, rotation pivot, world origin and ground contact anchor.
Derive camera near/far from model radius and location, verify projected corners for clipping.
Scale canvas resolution to quality budget rather than CSS size times unrestricted DPR.
Select key-fill-rim lights, environment intensity, tone mapping and plausible material roughness.
Compress textures, assign correct color space, downscale mobile mips and preload only visible assets.
Merge or instance repeated geometry to minimize GPU draw calls and memory overhead.
Measure instruction complexity, branch divergence and fill rate for GL fragment shaders.
Feature detect navigator.gpu; ship WebGL2 or poster fallback and test it.
Set max ray steps, early termination, distance epsilon, normal estimate and pixel budget.
Progressively accumulate samples, reset on camera move, use capped resolution and fallback.
Preserve temporal continuity and particle correspondence; simplify shaders on touch devices.
Use stable 2D wave simulation or baked deformation, bounded timestep and static fallback.
Decouple physics timestep from display FPS and cap substeps to avoid spiral of death.
Dispose geometry, materials, render targets, textures and event listeners upon unmount.
Use R3F demand frameloop for idle product scenes and invalidate on genuine changes.
Tie camera keyframes to normalized document scroll progress with one motion owner.
Normalize pointer into NDC from canvas bounds, raycast interactive objects and support touch.
Keep primary scene legible with lower LOD, fewer particles and reduced post-processing.
Project Box3 corners and compare with safe text rectangle; verify screenshots for mesh overlap.
Record model source, license, size, texture use and fallback poster without embedding unlicensed files.

cinematic-motion.objective: Single scroll progress signal drives text, models and camera through deterministic keyframes.
Default heading word or grapheme-safe text animation; preserve Persian glyph shaping.
Define enter, exit, stagger, hero orbit, hover and focus timing from approved brand tokens.
Clip letters or words inside overflow containers without hiding accessibility text.
Normalize pointer velocity, clamp force and introduce damping without layout reads every frame.
Ensure timeline fully reverses to original state on upward scrolling, no incremental drift.
Replace large transforms with stable readable content and minimal fades when user prefers.
Assign exclusive owners to transform, opacity and canvas uniforms per element.
Stop optional render loops when hidden/offscreen and resume from deterministic state.
Storyboard scene beats using explicit z/x/y camera positions and safe foreground space.

dynamic-agent-orchestration.objective: Select reviewers based on actual site type and observed features instead of fixed universal prompts.
Require approved brand JSON and compare each screenshot against its palette and motion rules.
Report severity, exact selector, source file and reproduction steps for design defects.
Preserve documented strengths so repair loops do not erase working and distinctive choices.
Check meaningful primary action, first-fold information and measured user flow.
Check cart state, pricing consistency, retries, trust and responsive payment flows.
Check data density, empty/loading/error states, keyboard, chart text alternatives.
Review camera composition, quality of materials, render placement and model storytelling.
Review DPR, instancing, shader cost, FPS distribution and asset disposal.
Review tap size, scroll trapping, orientation, pointer/touch fallback and low-end devices.
Check Arabic/Persian shaping, punctuation, digits, line breaking and actual loaded fonts.
Find timing clashes, excessive animations, conflicting transforms and missing reversibility.
Block broken focus order, screen reader labels and reduced-motion violations.
Review semantic content structure, nav, page metadata and link architecture.
Review data handling, form validation and unsafe third-party resource access.
Check text expansion, language-specific copy and direction switching without layout damage.
Synthesize independent reports with evidence and never erase a blocking failure by averaging scores.
Cap reviewer parallelism, output tokens, timeouts and total cost; retry safely once.
Normalize reports to JSON evidence schema and reject unsupported claims.
Declare NOT_TESTED when browser, model, font or approval is unavailable.

color-intelligence.objective: Render five semantic color variants on real CTA, card, form, navigation and state components.
Calculate WCAG contrast for text/background/CTA pairs and block failed required pairs.
Derive perceptually spaced chroma/lightness levels and clamp to output gamut.
Never change the brand color when approved tokens are locked; vary supporting surfaces only.
Synchronize dark and light semantic tokens including border and focus state.
Provide visual color-vision deficiency simulation plus redundant shape/text signals.
Prevent arbitrary equal-intensity accents; choose role-based hue/contrast hierarchy.
Include display-p3 as enhancement only with stable sRGB fallback.
Compare same page sections under all five palettes at identical viewport states.

brand-engine.objective: Require approved brand positioning, personality, audience, palette, fonts, logo and prohibitions.
Record which brand attribute justifies each major visual decision.
Keep logo clear space and minimum rendered size in every responsive configuration.
Generate standardized animation timing and curves from approved motion adjectives.
Verify provenance of logos, assets and fonts; avoid unknown copyrighted assets.
Keep tone, spacing and tokens consistent across every route and modal.
Require explicit approval to override locked identity constraint.

typography.objective: Route fa to a verified Persian-supporting font rather than visually similar unsupported Latin face.
Pair English headings/body to brand voice and x-height, avoiding forced same family.
Wait for document.fonts.ready and assert required family actually loaded, not just CSS declared.
Test 320px Persian headings, mixed digits, punctuation and long words in real browser.
Use clamp-based heading/body scale with target measure and no accidental clipping at zoom.
Isolate code, URLs, numbers and user-generated mixed-language spans semantically.
Subset where license permits, prefer WOFF2, avoid excessive preload and CLS.
Animate full words or wrappers instead of splitting Persian letters into broken glyphs.

responsive-intelligence.objective: Change component composition based on container width instead of global viewport only.
Let text length drive rows/columns and button wrapping without fixed height clipping.
Design for foldable segments and hinge-safe bounds with graceful single-screen fallback.
Limit content measure and separately place decorative 3D in ultra-wide space.
Verify short landscape heights, sticky sections and safe viewport height units.
Account for iOS/Android notches and bottom gesture insets.
Test 400 percent zoom using narrow effective viewport; avoid overflow and clipped controls.
Calculate actual DOM slot available to the model at each container size.
Never rely on hover as the only way to access controls or content.
Swap flow direction with logical properties and verify model/text order in both locales.
Avoid excessive tiny icons and data grids on mobile; use progressive disclosure.
Serve lower quality model and poster under Save-Data/slow connection when available.

design-critic.objective: Associate defect with screenshot, DOM selector and source path; use unknown if cannot map.
Rank critical usability and brand failures ahead of subtle visual polish.
Specify exactly what working content, motion and layouts must not change.
Review alignment grid, rhythm, whitespace, contrast and content scan path.
Review hover, focus, active, disabled, pending, error and success states.
Prefer animation serving hierarchy and comprehension instead of unrelated decoration.
Compare controlled before/after evidence to prove intended correction.

visual-originality.objective: Flag unsupported neon gradients, glass cards, repeated feature grids and stock-looking heroes.
Create motifs and interaction language grounded in real brand narrative and subject matter.
Vary rhythm, asymmetry and hierarchy only when they improve task clarity.
Do not sacrifice task completion and accessibility for visual distinctiveness.
Use type contrast, editorial scale and white space instead of random decoration.

motion-design-language.objective: Define duration/easing/delay/distance and reduced-motion variants as reusable tokens.
Keep click/hover response fast and restrained; avoid startling motion on every event.
Use grouped stagger with cap on total entrance sequence duration.
Preserve navigation context, focus, scroll restoration and reduced-motion behavior.
Treat scroll as progress not velocity-dependent accumulated transforms.
Use physically coherent damping and mass across cards, camera and cursor where appropriate.
Declare one owner for every animated property to prevent competing CSS/GSAP/Anime updates.

gpu-optimization.objective: Use runtime p95 frametime feedback to lower DPR smoothly with hysteresis.
Use InstancedMesh and geometry batching when objects share geometry and material.
Choose LOD by projected pixel size and mobile device budget.
Reduce expensive bloom, DOF and SSR passes before destroying primary motion.
Profile shader instruction hotspots and overdraw on target hardware.
Release geometries/materials/textures when switching routes or models.
Suspend hidden canvases and unobserved timelines to save battery.
Use 95th percentile frame time, not only average FPS, when choosing quality level.

scroll-performance.objective: Centralize visual DOM reads and writes on one animation frame pipeline.
Use passive scroll listeners and avoid work in wheel handlers.
Suspend expensive animation work outside viewport while keeping scroll state correct.
Batch getBoundingClientRect reads before modifying layout-affecting properties.
Derive normalized section progress from actual geometry on resize and content change.
Avoid stacking or clipping bugs from nested transform and overflow parents.
Guarantee reverse scrubbing returns original transform/opacity every time.
If smooth-scroll used, keep native navigation/accessibility behavior and sync one source.

font-performance.objective: Self-host verified licensed WOFF2 font assets; do not bundle proprietary fonts.
Separate Persian and Latin Unicode ranges with safe shaping and fallback coverage.
Choose font-display strategy according to CLS and legibility requirements.
Only preload critical font files and avoid speculative font downloads.
Use size-adjust and metric overrides where measured to reduce layout shift.

code-quality.objective: Limit component responsibility and separate render engine lifecycle from UI view tree.
Review event listeners, observers and animation contexts for deterministic disposal.
Validate unknown API/asset data and produce user-facing error states.
Run TypeScript compiler, lint, unit and browser tests before declaring success.
Avoid mutated React state and expensive render churn with proper memo boundaries.
Use deterministic dependency lockfile and scripts documented for Windows.

dependency-intelligence.objective: Inspect installed react/three/fiber/drei/tailwind/bootstrap versions, not guesses.
Audit multiple versions of GSAP/Anime/Motion controlling same element.
Use npm ci/pnpm frozen lockfile where appropriate, no uncontrolled auto-update.
Check peer compatibility of React Three Fiber and React versions.
Run package audit and interpret alerts for actual exposure, no blind breaking updates.
Document licenses for third-party models, fonts and visuals.

mobile-performance.objective: Retain hero and primary transitions while shrinking optional particle and blur budgets.
Lower dormant animation refresh and idle GPU usage instead of disabling entire scene.
Honor supported Save-Data and constrained network with lite asset paths.
Use sustained frame-time feedback rather than unsupported thermal APIs.
Check touch reaction time and avoid costly per-pointer DOM writes.
Recompute FOV/framing when canvas aspect ratio changes; never crop essential subject.
Label emulator as emulator; verify actual low-end Android and iOS before strong FPS claims.
Report trade-offs (DPR, LOD, shadows, postFx) in quality policy evidence.

accessibility.objective: Preserve full content and controls when animations simplify or stop.
Check tab sequence and visible focus for all interactive elements.
Give models alt/context description and equivalent non-WebGL content.
Avoid relying on color alone for success/error indicators.
Associate validation errors to input, announce via accessible live region.
Provide keyboard/touch actions for drag-only and hover-only interactions.
Maintain controls and text at narrow widths corresponding to high zoom.

browser-testing.objective: Collect viewport screenshot matrix and report overflow/heading visibility.
Capture exact 0/33/68/100% scroll positions and compare expected scene state.
Test no-preference and reduce modes separately.
Toggle RTL/LTR, await fonts, inspect actual typography and clipping.
Collect pageerror and requestfailed rather than hiding them.
Keep environmental constants, compare same screenshots, require review for intended changes.
Expose a test hook for WebGL timeline progress to freeze custom canvas loops.
Exercise nav, forms, dialogs and buttons rather than screenshot-only audits.
Add manual device testing checklists for Safari and physical Android beyond emulation.
